text:
li: Heads-up — found a docs mismatch in the /v1/files/upload example. The request example uses JSON but the server expects multipart/form-data. Also the response example shows "file_id" while the API actually returns "fileId".

maria: ack. thanks for catching. do you have a suggested fix?

li: minimal: update curl example to use -F, add content-type note, and change response example keys to camelCase. also update the OpenAPI example -> requestBody.content.

sam: i can open a small PR. example curl i was thinking: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/files/upload" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -F "file=@model_input.json;type=application/json" \n  -F "purpose=training"
```

sam: note: some SDKs accept a file stream; we should keep a comment for that in the python/js snippets.

jordan: also check the python snippet — right now it constructs a dict and sends json=... which is wrong. i can update the python and node examples to use multipart/form-data helpers.

li: thanks. one more tiny thing: the response example used HTTP/1.1 200 and an example body with "file_id": "abc" — server returns {"fileId": "abc", "name": "model_input.json"}. pls make the example match.

docs-bot: docs-ci found a lint error in docs/files.md: example code block missing language tag on line 42.

sam: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/docs/pull/512 — fixes curl + response example + openapi requestBody content-type. i added a changelog note under docs/changes.md.

maria: on it. i'll run the link checker locally and give a quick review.

jordan: i'll update sdk snippets in the same PR if you want me to push a follow-up commit (python + node).

sam: please do — i'd rather keep examples consistent. thanks.

maria: quick review done, left 2 nits (code fence lang for the curl block, and a one-line clarifier about streaming uploads). once those are fixed and CI is green, i vote merge. :shipit:

sam: pushed fixes for the nits and updated OpenAPI example. CI is green. merging in 5.

li: awesome — thanks everyone. can we add a short migration note in the docs for anyone relying on the old JSON example? i can draft a 2-line note.

jordan: i'll add the SDK snippet changes to the PR description and call out the breaking example.

sam: merged. closing the loop — updated live docs page and OpenAPI spec.

li: closing thread — thanks all.
